description: Calculate the official تعرفهٔ دستمزد کارشناسان رسمی دادگستری (1398/12/25, amended 1402/08). `valuation` is a marginal ladder on the ارزش موضوع کارشناسی (art. 11) with a hard per-expert cap and explicit percentage add-ons for a few named subject matters (art. 11 notes 3–7, art. 22(2)); `residual` is the flat minimum for expert work with no specific tariff in this instrument (art. 9); `evidence` is the flat minimum for تأمین دلیل (art. 7). Dozens of OTHER specialties (arts. 13–55) carry their own separate tariff and are not modelled here. Never guess a court expert's statutory fee.

expert_count.description: Number of same-specialty experts working the SAME subject jointly (valuation only). More than 1 applies a 30% reduction per expert (art. 11 note 6). Default 1 (no reduction). Do not use for a multi-specialty panel — price each specialty separately.

kind.description: valuation = art. 11 ladder (needs value_rial); residual = flat minimum, no specific tariff (art. 9); evidence = تأمین دلیل flat minimum (art. 7).

modifiers.description: valuation only; usually at most one: contract_dispute = employer/contractor/consulting-engineer dispute or صورت‌وضعیت review over the whole contract value (+100%, art. 11 note 3); contract_dispute_partial = appraisal of only part of the contract, e.g. finding breach or delay (+50%, note 3); damage_assessment = determining cause and extent of damage (+50%, note 4); used_goods = used parts/goods/food-drug-hygiene items/scrap/tools/micro-electronics, standalone (+50%, note 5); intangible_assets = brand and other intangibles (+50%, note 7); underground_mine = underground mineral reserves (+35%, art. 22(2)).

travel_days_other_province.description: Mission days outside the expert's own province (art. 6).

travel_days_same_province.description: Mission days within the expert's own province (art. 6 daily travel allowance) — added to any kind.

value_rial.description: Value of the subject matter under appraisal, in RIAL — valuation only. Never pass Toman.
